Aid.components: V, S, M (a strip of white cloth)
Aid.text: Up to three creatures within range each raise their HP maximum and current HP by 5 for the duration.

Armor of Agathys.components: V, S, M (a shard of blue glass)
Armor of Agathys.text: Gain 5 Temporary HP. While you still have them, any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage. Ends early once the Temporary HP are gone.
Armor of Agathys.higher: +5 Temporary HP and +5 cold damage per slot level above 1st.

Bane.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood)
Bane.text: Up to three creatures make a Cha save. Each that fails subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls and saving throws for the duration.

2014.text: A willing creature's skin turns bark-hard: its AC can't drop below 16 for the duration, whatever armor it wears.

Barkskin.components: V, S, M (a handful of oak bark)
Barkskin.text: A willing creature's skin turns bark-hard: its AC is 17 for the duration if it would otherwise be lower.

2014.components: V, S, M (a sprinkling of holy water)

Bless.components: V, S, M (a holy symbol worth 5+ gp)
Bless.text: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to every attack roll and saving throw they make for the duration.

Burning Hands.text: Flames fan out in the cone: Dex save, 3d6 fire on a fail, half on a success. Unattended flammable objects in the cone catch fire.

Calm Emotions.text: Humanoids in the sphere make a Cha save (they can choose to fail). For each that fails, pick one: suppress any Charmed or Frightened on it, or make it indifferent to creatures it's hostile toward until it or its allies are hurt.

Charm Person.text: One Humanoid makes a Wis save (with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it) or is Charmed by you, treating you as a friendly acquaintance. Ends if you or your allies harm it. It knows it was charmed afterward.
Charm Person.higher: +1 target per slot level above 1st; targets must be within 30 ft of each other.

2014.text: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 necrotic, and the target can't regain HP until the start of your next turn. An Undead hit also has disadvantage on attacks against you until then.

Chill Touch.text: Melee spell attack against a creature in reach: 1d10 necrotic, and it can't regain HP until the end of your next turn.

Clairvoyance.components: V, S, M (a focus worth 100+ gp: a jeweled horn or a glass eye)
Clairvoyance.text: Plant an invisible sensor at a place within range you know or can see. Pick sight or hearing and perceive through the sensor as if you stood there; Bonus Action to swap senses. Creatures that see invisible things notice it as a small orb.

2014.text: Roll 6d10: that's how many HP of creatures you affect. Starting with the lowest current HP, each creature in the cone (skip unconscious or sightless ones) is Blinded until your next turn ends, subtracting its HP from the pool. No save.
2014.higher: +2d10 to the HP pool per slot level above 1st.

Color Spray.components: V, S, M (a pinch of colorful sand)
Color Spray.text: Dazzling colors fill the cone: each creature in it makes a Con save or is Blinded until the end of your next turn.

2014.text: Bark a one-word order at a creature you can see. Wis save or it obeys on its next turn (approach, drop, flee, grovel, halt, or similar). No effect on Undead, on a target that doesn't know your language, or if the order is directly harmful to it.

Command.text: Bark a one-word order at a creature you can see. Wis save or it obeys on its next turn: Approach (come to you), Drop (what it holds), Flee (away from you), Grovel (fall Prone), or Halt (do nothing, no moving).

2014.text: Reaction when you see a creature within 60 ft casting a spell: a spell of 3rd level or lower just fails. For a higher one, make a spellcasting ability check, DC 10 + its level, to stop it. No save for the caster.
2014.higher: Automatically stops spells of a level up to the slot you use.

Counterspell.text: Reaction when you see a creature within 60 ft casting a spell with V, S, or M components: it makes a Con save. On a fail the spell fizzles, its action is wasted, and any slot it used is not spent.

2014.text: The creature you touch regains 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP. Does nothing to Undead or Constructs.

Cure Wounds.text: The creature you touch regains 2d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP.

Dancing Lights.components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus)
Dancing Lights.text: Make up to four torch-like lights (or merge them into one glowing Medium figure), each giving dim light in a 10-ft radius. Bonus Action: move them up to 60 ft. Each must stay within 20 ft of another and within range, or it winks out.

Detect Magic.text: You sense magic within 30 ft of you. Use an action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object carrying magic and learn the school of any spell on it. Blocked by 1 ft of stone, dirt, or wood, 1 inch of metal, or thin lead.

Detect Thoughts.text: On cast and as an action later: sense thinking creatures within 30 ft, or read what's on one creature's mind there. Next turn you can probe deeper: Wis save or you learn its reasoning and worries; on a success the spell ends.

Disguise Self.text: Change how you, your clothes, and your gear look: up to 1 ft taller or shorter, heavier or thinner, but the same basic body shape. Touch gives it away; a careful look calls for an Int (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

Dispel Magic.text: Pick a creature, object, or magical effect. Spells of 3rd level or lower on it end. For each higher-level spell, make a spellcasting ability check, DC 10 + its level, to end it.
Dispel Magic.higher: Automatically ends spells of a level up to the slot you use.

Dissonant Whispers.text: A creature only it can hear: Wis save. Fail: 3d6 psychic and it must spend its Reaction to move its full speed away from you (avoiding obvious hazards). Success: half damage, no move. Deafened creatures pass automatically.

Druidcraft.text: Pick one small nature trick: forecast the local weather for 24 hours; make a flower bloom or a bud open; a harmless sensory effect in a 5-ft cube (falling leaves, a breeze, an animal sound); or light or snuff a candle, torch, or small campfire.

Eldritch Blast.text: Fire a beam of crackling force: ranged spell attack, 1d10 force on a hit.
Eldritch Blast.higher: 2 beams at 5th level, 3 at 11th, 4 at 17th; each is its own attack, at one target or several.

Entangle.text: Grasping weeds fill the square, which becomes difficult terrain. Each creature in it other than you: Str save or Restrained for the duration. A Restrained creature can use its action on a Str (Athletics) check against your DC to break free.

Faerie Fire.text: Each creature and object in the cube: Dex save or be outlined in light (dim light, 10 ft) for the duration. Outlined targets can't benefit from being Invisible, and attacks against them have advantage if the attacker can see them.

2014.text: Gain 1d4 + 4 Temporary HP, which last for the duration.

False Life.components: V, S, M (a drop of alcohol)
False Life.higher: +5 Temporary HP per slot level above 1st.

Fear.text: Each creature in the cone: Wis save or drop what it's holding and be Frightened. While Frightened it must Dash away from you by the safest route. If it ends a turn where it can't see you, it repeats the save, ending the effect on a success.

2014.components: V, S, M (10 gp of charcoal, incense, and herbs, burned)
2014.text: Summon a spirit familiar in a tiny beast's shape (cat, owl, rat, raven, etc.). It obeys you, can't attack, and talks to you mind-to-mind within 100 ft. Action: see and hear through it (you're blind and deaf meanwhile). It can deliver touch spells.

Find Familiar.components: V, S, M (burning incense worth 10+ gp, consumed)
Find Familiar.text: Summon a spirit familiar in a tiny beast's shape (cat, owl, rat, raven, etc.). It obeys you, can't attack, and talks to you mind-to-mind within 100 ft. Bonus Action: see and hear through it until your next turn. It can deliver your touch spells.

Fire Bolt.text: Hurl a mote of fire: ranged spell attack, 1d10 fire on a hit. Unattended flammable objects it hits catch fire.

Fog Cloud.text: A 20-ft-radius sphere of thick fog appears, spreading around corners. Its area is heavily obscured. A strong wind breaks it up.
Fog Cloud.higher: +20 ft radius per slot level above 1st.

2014.text: Pick a creature that isn't hostile to you: you have advantage on all Cha checks aimed at it for the duration. When the spell ends, it realizes you used magic on it and may turn hostile.

Friends.text: A Humanoid you can see that isn't fighting you: Wis save or Charmed by you. Ends early if it takes damage or you attack, deal damage, or force a save on anyone. When it ends, the target knows you charmed it.

Gentle Repose.components: V, S, M (salt and a copper piece on each eye of the corpse)
Gentle Repose.text: A corpse you touch can't decay or rise as Undead for the duration. Those days don't count toward time limits on spells like Revivify.

2014.text: Up to ten berries become magic. A creature can eat one as an action to regain 1 HP; one berry also feeds a creature for a day. The berries lose their magic after 24 hours.

Goodberry.components: V, S, M (a sprig of mistletoe)
Goodberry.text: Ten magic berries appear in your hand. A creature can eat one as a Bonus Action to regain 1 HP; one berry also feeds a creature for a day. Uneaten berries vanish when the spell ends.

2014.text: Touch a willing creature. Once before the spell ends, it can add 1d4 to one ability check of its choice (before or after rolling), and then the spell ends.

Guidance.text: Touch a willing creature and name a skill. Until the spell ends, it adds 1d4 to every ability check it makes with that skill.

Guiding Bolt.text: Ranged spell attack: 4d6 radiant on a hit, and the next attack roll against that target before the end of your next turn has advantage.

Gust of Wind.text: A 60-ft by 10-ft blast of wind. Creatures in it: Str save or shoved 15 ft away from you (on cast and when they start a turn there). Moving toward you through it costs double. Scatters gas, snuffs open flames. Bonus Action: turn the line.

2014.text: A creature you can see within range regains 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier HP. Does nothing to Undead or Constructs.

Healing Word.text: A creature you can see within range regains 2d4 + your spellcasting modifier HP.

2014.higher: Lasts up to 8 hours with a 3rd- or 4th-level slot, 24 hours with 5th+.

Hex.components: V, S, M (the petrified eye of a newt)
Hex.text: Curse a creature: your attacks that hit it deal +1d6 necrotic, and it has disadvantage on checks with one ability you name. If it drops to 0 HP, move the curse to a new creature with a Bonus Action on a later turn.
Hex.higher: Lasts up to 4 hours with a 2nd-level slot, 8 hours with 3rd-4th, 24 hours with 5th+.

Hold Person.components: V, S, M (a straight piece of iron)
Hold Person.text: A Humanoid you can see: Wis save or Paralyzed for the duration. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Hold Person.higher: +1 Humanoid per slot level above 2nd; targets within 30 ft of each other.

Hunger of Hadar.text: A 20-ft-radius sphere of freezing void: magical darkness, difficult terrain, and Blinded inside. A creature starting its turn there takes 2d6 cold; one ending its turn there makes a Dex save or takes 2d6 acid.
Hunger of Hadar.higher: +1d6 to the cold or acid damage (your pick) per slot level above 3rd.

2014.components: S, M (a glowing stick of incense or a vial of phosphorescent stuff)

Hypnotic Pattern.text: Each creature in the cube that can see the swirling colors: Wis save or Charmed; while Charmed it's Incapacitated with Speed 0. It snaps out if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake it awake.

Identify.components: V, S, M (a pearl worth 100+ gp)
Identify.text: Touch an object: learn its magic properties, how to use them, whether it needs attunement, and its charges. Or touch a creature or object to learn what spells currently affect it.

2014.text: A creature you touch, plus what it wears and carries, is invisible for the duration. Ends for that creature once it attacks or casts a spell.

Invisibility.components: V, S, M (an eyelash in gum arabic)
Invisibility.text: A creature you touch, plus what it wears and carries, is Invisible for the duration. Ends for that creature once it makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

2014.text: End one disease or one condition on the creature you touch: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

Lesser Restoration.text: End one condition on the creature you touch: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

Light.components: V, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)
Light.text: An object up to 10 ft across glows: bright light 20 ft, dim light 20 ft beyond, any color. Covering it blocks the light. Casting it again ends the old one. An object held by a hostile creature needs it to fail a Dex save.

Mage Armor.components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)
Mage Armor.text: A willing creature wearing no armor gets a base AC of 13 + its Dex modifier. Ends if it puts on armor or you end the spell.

Mage Hand.text: A floating spectral hand appears. With an action you can move it up to 30 ft and use it to handle objects, open unlocked doors or containers, stow or fetch items, or pour a vial. It can't attack, use magic items, or lift over 10 lb.

2014.text: Up to six creatures you can see within range each regain 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier HP. Does nothing to Undead or Constructs.

Mass Healing Word.text: Up to six creatures you can see within range each regain 2d4 + your spellcasting modifier HP.

Mending.text: Fix one break or tear in an object (a snapped key, torn cloak, leaking flask) no bigger than 1 ft in any direction, leaving no mark. It can mend a magic item's body but not restore its magic.

2014.components: V, S, M (a short copper wire)

Message.text: Point at a creature and whisper: only it hears you, and it can whisper a reply only you hear. Works around obstacles if you know where it is. Stopped by magical silence, 1 ft of stone, metal, or wood, or thin lead.

Minor Illusion.text: Make either a sound or a still image (no bigger than a 5-ft cube, no light or smell). Touching the image shows it's fake. A creature studying it makes an Int (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to see through it.

2014.text: Three illusory copies of you. When a creature targets you with an attack, roll a d20: 6+ with 3 copies, 8+ with 2, 11+ with 1 means it targets a copy (AC 10 + your Dex mod; a hit destroys it). Doesn't fool Blindsight or Truesight.

Mirror Image.text: Three illusory copies of you appear. When an attack roll hits you, roll a d6 per copy left: if any shows 3+, a copy takes the hit and pops instead. Creatures that are Blinded or have Blindsight or Truesight ignore the copies.

Misty Step.text: Teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied spot you can see, in a puff of silver mist.

2014.text: A 40-ft-tall pillar of moonlight (dim light). A creature entering it for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there: Con save, 2d10 radiant, half on a success. Shapechangers save at disadvantage and revert on a fail. Action: move it 60 ft.

Moonbeam.text: A 40-ft-tall pillar of moonlight (dim light). Creatures in it on cast, entering it, or ending a turn there: Con save, 2d10 radiant, half on a success (once per turn). A shapeshifted creature that fails reverts. Action: move it 60 ft.

Pass Without Trace.components: V, S, M (ashes from burned mistletoe)
Pass Without Trace.text: A hushing aura spreads 30 ft around you and moves with you. You and the creatures you choose in it get +10 to Dex (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.

2014.text: Int save or the target sees a fake object, creature, or hazard (up to a 10-ft cube) only it perceives, and explains away anything odd. It can deal 1d6 psychic to the target on each of your turns if the target is in or within 5 ft of it.

Phantasmal Force.components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
Phantasmal Force.text: Int save or the target sees a fake object, creature, or hazard (up to a 10-ft cube) only it perceives, and explains away anything odd. Once per round on your turn it can deal 2d8 psychic if the target is in or within 5 ft of it.

Prestidigitation.text: Small magic trick: a harmless sensory effect; light or snuff a candle or small fire; clean or soil a small object; chill, warm, or flavor food; leave a mark or color for an hour; or make a palm-sized trinket or image until your next turn ends.

2014.text: A flame flickers in your hand: bright light 10 ft, dim light 10 ft beyond. On cast or as a later action, throw it at a creature within 30 ft: ranged spell attack, 1d8 fire. Throwing it ends the spell.

Produce Flame.text: A flame flickers in your hand: bright light 20 ft, dim light 20 ft beyond. While it lasts, use an action to hurl fire at a creature or object within 60 ft: ranged spell attack, 1d8 fire. Ends if you cast it again.

2014.components: V, S, M (holy water or powdered silver and iron, consumed)

Protection from Evil and Good.components: V, S, M (a flask of holy water worth 25 gp, consumed)
Protection from Evil and Good.text: Ward a willing creature against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead: they attack it with disadvantage and can't newly charm, frighten, or possess it. If it's already under such an effect, it has advantage on saves against it.

2014.text: Ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength. It makes a Con save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

Ray of Enfeeblement.text: Con save. Fail: disadvantage on Str-based checks, attacks, and saves, and -1d8 on its damage rolls; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Success: disadvantage on its next attack roll before your next turn.

Ray of Frost.text: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 cold on a hit, and the target's speed drops by 10 ft until the start of your next turn.

Revivify.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 300+ gp, consumed)
Revivify.text: Touch a creature that died in the last minute: it comes back with 1 HP. Doesn't work on death from old age and doesn't restore lost body parts.

Sacred Flame.text: Radiance falls on a creature you can see: Dex save or 1d8 radiant. Half and three-quarters cover don't help it.

2014.text: Ward a creature. Anyone targeting it with an attack or harmful spell makes a Wis save first; on a fail it must pick a new target or lose the attack or spell. Area effects still hit. Ends if the ward attacks or casts a spell that affects an enemy.

Sanctuary.components: V, S, M (a shard of mirror glass)
Sanctuary.text: Ward a creature. Anyone targeting it with an attack roll or a damaging spell makes a Wis save first; on a fail it must pick a new target or waste the attack or spell. Area effects still hit. Ends if the ward attacks, casts a spell, or deals damage.

Scorching Ray.text: Fire three rays at one target or several: a ranged spell attack for each, 2d6 fire per hit.

See Invisibility.components: V, S, M (a pinch of talc and powdered silver)
See Invisibility.text: For the duration you see Invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane (things there look ghostly).

Shatter.components: V, S, M (a chip of mica)
Shatter.text: A painful ringing burst: each creature in the sphere makes a Con save, 3d8 thunder on a fail, half on a success. Creatures of stone, crystal, or metal save at disadvantage. Loose objects in the area take the damage too.

Shield.text: Reaction when an attack would hit you or you're targeted by Magic Missile: +5 AC until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack, and Magic Missile can't hurt you.

2014.components: V, S, M (a scrap of parchment with holy writing)

Shield of Faith.text: A shimmering field surrounds a creature of your choice in range: +2 AC for the duration.

2014.components: V, S, M (mistletoe, a shamrock leaf, and a club or quarterstaff)
2014.text: A club or quarterstaff you hold uses your spellcasting ability instead of Str for its attack and damage rolls, its damage die becomes a d8, and it counts as magical. Ends if you cast it again or let go.

Shillelagh.text: A club or quarterstaff you hold uses your spellcasting ability for its attack and damage rolls, its damage die becomes a d8, and its hits can deal force instead of bludgeoning. Ends if you cast it again or let go.
Shillelagh.higher: Damage die becomes a d10 at 5th level, d12 at 11th, 2d6 at 17th.

2014.text: Melee spell attack, with advantage if the target wears metal armor: 1d8 lightning on a hit, and the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

Shocking Grasp.text: Melee spell attack: 1d8 lightning on a hit, and the target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

Silent Image.components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
Silent Image.text: Create a soundless, smell-less image of a thing, creature, or effect up to a 15-ft cube. Use an action to move it and make it look natural. Touching it reveals it; a studying creature makes Int (Investigation) against your DC.

2014.components: V, S, M (a pinch of sand, rose petals, or a cricket)
2014.text: Roll 5d8: the HP of creatures you affect. Lowest current HP first, each creature in the sphere falls Unconscious, using its HP from the pool. Damage or a shake (an action) wakes them. No save; Undead and charm-immune creatures ignore it.
2014.higher: +2d8 to the HP pool per slot level above 1st.

Sleep.components: V, S, M (a pinch of sand or rose petals)
Sleep.text: Creatures you choose in the sphere: Wis save or Incapacitated until their next turn ends, then save again or fall Unconscious. Damage or a shake (an action) wakes them. Creatures that don't sleep or can't be exhausted are immune.

2014.text: A living creature you touch at 0 HP becomes stable. Does nothing to Undead or Constructs.

Spare the Dying.text: A creature in range at 0 HP that isn't dead becomes Stable.
Spare the Dying.higher: Range doubles at 5th level (30 ft), 11th (60 ft), and 17th (120 ft).

2014.text: Spirits circle 15 ft around you; spared creatures are your pick. Others there move at half speed. A creature entering for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there: Wis save, 3d8 radiant (necrotic if evil), half on a success.

Spirit Guardians.text: Spirits circle 15 ft around you; spared creatures are your pick. Others there move at half speed. When the aura reaches one or it enters or ends a turn there: Wis save, 3d8 radiant (necrotic if you're evil), half on a success. Once per turn.

2014.higher: +1d8 force for every two slot levels above 2nd.

Spiritual Weapon.text: A floating spectral weapon appears. On cast, melee spell attack a creature within 5 ft of it: 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier force. Bonus Action on later turns: move it up to 20 ft and attack again.

Starry Wisp.text: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 radiant on a hit. Until the end of your next turn the target glows (dim light, 10 ft) and can't benefit from being Invisible.

2014.components: V, M (a snake's tongue and honeycomb or sweet oil)
2014.text: Suggest a reasonable-sounding course of action (a sentence or two) to a creature that can hear and understand you. Wis save or it pursues it as best it can. Charm-immune creatures ignore it. Ends early if you or your allies damage it.

Suggestion.text: Suggest a reasonable-sounding course of action (25 words or fewer) to a creature that can hear and understand you. Wis save or it's Charmed and pursues it as best it can. Ends early if you or your allies damage it.

2014.text: A creature you can see: Wis save or prone and incapacitated with laughter, unable to stand. Int 4 or lower is immune. It saves again at the end of each of its turns and when it takes damage (with advantage then), ending it on a success.

Tasha's Hideous Laughter.components: V, S, M (a tart and a feather)
Tasha's Hideous Laughter.text: A creature you can see: Wis save or Prone and Incapacitated with laughter, unable to stand. It saves again at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage (with advantage then), ending it on a success.

Thaumaturgy.text: A minor wonder: your voice booms three times louder; flames flicker, flare, dim, or change color; the ground trembles harmlessly; a sudden sound rings out; an unlocked door or window bangs open or shut; or your eyes change. Up to 3 at once.

Thorn Whip.components: V, S, M (the stem of a thorny plant)
Thorn Whip.text: Lash a creature with a thorny vine: melee spell attack, 1d6 piercing on a hit, and if it's Large or smaller you pull it up to 10 ft toward you.

Thunderclap.text: A thunderous crack: every other creature within 5 ft of you makes a Con save or takes 1d6 thunder. Audible 100 ft away.

Thunderwave.text: A wave of force: each creature in the cube makes a Con save. Fail: 2d8 thunder and pushed 10 ft away. Success: half, no push. Loose objects are flung 10 ft. The boom carries 300 ft.

Toll the Dead.text: A mournful bell tolls for a creature you can see: Wis save or take 1d8 necrotic, or 1d12 if it's already missing any HP.

2014.text: Insult a creature that can hear you: Wis save or 1d4 psychic and disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

Vicious Mockery.text: Insult a creature that can hear you: Wis save or 1d6 psychic and disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

Word of Radiance.text: Speak a burning word: creatures you choose within 5 ft of you each make a Con save or take 1d6 radiant.

Zone of Truth.text: Creatures entering the sphere for the first time on a turn or starting a turn there: Cha save or they can't tell a deliberate lie while inside. You know who failed. They know of the spell and can still dodge questions.
